mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect 61 degrees with partly cloudy skies at Fireman's Park. Also, keep your eyes on the skies tonight at 5:49 PM for a 3-minute ISS flyover, moving from the northwest over Verona High School toward the northeast near Home Depot.

The city is preparing for Thanksgiving with closures for all city buildings on November 26 and 27. Additionally, the Public Works department is planning an expansion to better serve our growing population, while road reconstruction continues on Mark Drive.
There is plenty to do, with live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's happening today, followed by Wisconsin Brewing Company hosting live music tomorrow.
On November 3, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash at CTH M and CTH PB, resulting in a driver being cited for operating without required headlights.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Crazy for Cookie Dough. The store is currently open and will be serving up scoops until 10:30 PM tonight.
